title: Impute-EM: Native Mixed-State Diffusion Models for Heterogeneous Data Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2609.15284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Missing values are ubiquitous in heterogeneous data mining, where numerical, categorical, and binary variables often coexist. Many imputation methods, especially diffusion-based ones, treat discrete variables through continuous surrogates such as one-hot relaxations rather than modeling them natively. This creates a mismatch between the model state space and the mixed discrete and continuous structure of the data. We propose Impute-EM, an Expectation Maximization style framework that alternates between imputing missing entries with the current model and refitting a diffusion backbone on completed data. We instantiate Impute-EM with native mixed-state diffusion backbones for heterogeneous data, combining Gaussian and masked categorical components without one-hot relaxations. translated_title: Impute-EM：面向异构数据插补的原生混合状态扩散模型
translated_abstract: 缺失值在异构数据挖掘中无处不在，其中数值型、类别型和二值型变量常常共存。许多插补方法，尤其是基于扩散模型的方法，通过连续代理（如独热one-hot松弛）来处理离散变量，而非对其进行原生建模。这在模型状态空间与数据离散-连续混合结构之间造成了不匹配。我们提出Impute-EM，一个期望最大化（EM）风格的框架，它在用当前模型插补缺失条目与在补全数据上重新拟合扩散主干网络之间交替进行。我们使用面向异构数据的原生混合状态扩散主干来实例化Impute-EM，该方法结合高斯分量与掩码类别分量，无需独热松弛。在精确设置下，我们刻画了该更新过程，并证明了以掩码为索引的观测边缘分布在极限处与目标分布相匹配，同时明确指出了完整数据……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出Impute-EM框架，通过EM式交替进行缺失值插补与扩散模型重训练，并采用结合高斯分量与掩码类别分量的原生混合状态扩散模型（无需独热松弛）来实现异构数据的有效插补。
en_tdlr: Proposes Impute-EM, an EM-style framework that alternates between imputing missing entries and refitting native mixed-state diffusion backbones combining Gaussian and masked categorical components without one-hot relaxations, for heterogeneous data imputation.
